steps: Make the Sign of the Cross.
Announce the first mystery of the day's cycle and pause briefly to recall it; if you wish, read the biblical passage indicated.
Pray ten Hail Marys, meditating on the mystery.
Repeat for each of the five mysteries of the cycle.
At the end, you may pray the Hail, Holy Queen or another Marian prayer.
rosario.stepsNote: Structure of each mystery as on the Vatican website (announcement, Our Father, ten Hail Marys meditating on the mystery, Glory Be). The exact order of the opening and closing prayers varies between communities and has not been standardized here by any document; the opening Sign of the Cross and the closing Hail, Holy Queen are common practices.
